surface: Internal reference executable consuming packed NativeWeave APIs
xmlDocumentation: Generated by Reference.TaskService.csproj; implementation comments retain internal lifetime and persistence rules
sourceBinding: Plan/source-driven-baseline.json and tasks/B21.md bind exact design inputs; no design stub is copied as an implementation

nativeMapping.http: NativeWeave.Server -> existing Server ABI -> Rust Hyper/Axum/Tokio/rustls Host
nativeMapping.query: Static Table/Column/Projection -> NativeWeave.Database/Query -> existing database ABI -> Rust SeaQuery/SQLx
nativeMapping.transaction: DataSession/Transaction -> existing native transaction coordinator and real SQLx provider
nativeMapping.claim: One trusted typed SqlCommand DO NOTHING RETURNING recipe -> Rust parameter binding/SQLx; a following native-backed FindAsync supplies the fresh PostgreSQL statement snapshot
nativeMapping.blob: Application filesystem I/O; bounded Server streams retain their existing native/managed credits; directory durability uses internal OS calls

platformScope: Linux x64 only; Windows execution and filesystem acceptance remain unverified
acceptance: Actual task evidence belongs in Plan/ledger/evidence/B21; source compilation or this manifest alone never implies acceptance
